title: Can a Daily Handful of Almonds Boost Your Bone Health?

scenes.text: What if 30 g of almonds could strengthen your bones?
Almonds provide about 75 mg of calcium per ounce, supporting bone density.
They also contain magnesium, which aids vitamin D activation for calcium absorption.
Add a small handful (≈30 g) of almonds daily for bone support.
scenes.label: DAILY HANDFUL
scenes.sub: Just 30 g a day can help keep bones strong

scenes.text: Follow for simple habits that boost your health.

description: Discover how a modest daily portion of almonds packs calcium, magnesium, and other bone‑friendly nutrients. Try it today and feel the difference.
